mapper.sql: id, task_id, tenant_id, run_uuid, attempt_number, status, scheduled_at, lease_holder, lease_expires_at, heartbeat_at, dispatch_count, model, style, max_tool_steps, token_usage, tool_calls_count, error_code, error_detail, failed_tool, started_at, completed_at, duration_ms, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_run WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY attempt_number ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_run SET status = #{status}, model = #{model}, token_usage = #{tokenUsage, typeHandler=com.hfusionhub.handler.JsonMapTypeHandler}, tool_calls_count = #{toolCallsCount}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_detail = #{errorDetail}, failed_tool = #{failedTool}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE agent_run SET status = 'running', lease_holder = #{holder}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt}, heartbeat_at = #{heartbeatAt}, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, #{now}), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'pending' AND (scheduled_at IS NULL OR scheduled_at <= #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_run WHERE status = 'pending' AND (scheduled_at IS NULL OR scheduled_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY scheduled_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_run SET lease_holder = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, heartbeat_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND lease_holder = #{holder}

UPDATE agent_run SET status = #{status}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_detail = #{errorDetail}, failed_tool = #{failedTool}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, duration_ms = COALESCE(duration_ms, 0), lease_holder = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, heartbeat_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('running', 'waiting_approval')

UPDATE agent_run SET model = COALESCE(#{model}, model), token_usage = #{tokenUsage, typeHandler=com.hfusionhub.handler.JsonMapTypeHandler}, tool_calls_count = #{toolCallsCount}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE agent_run SET status = 'pending', run_uuid = #{runUuid}, scheduled_at = #{scheduledAt}, dispatch_count = dispatch_count + 1, started_at = NULL, token_usage = NULL, tool_calls_count = 0, duration_ms = 0, error_code = NULL, error_detail = NULL, failed_tool = NULL, lease_holder = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, heartbeat_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'running'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_run WHERE lease_holder = #{holder} AND status = 'running'
